description: Set how much the Nock Agent does alone for one action type in this workspace: 1 only tells, 2 suggests and does it with one tap (default), 3 does it and tells after. Whatever the level, the Agent still waits for approval before spending above a routine's credit cap, deleting, messaging leads with a cadence nobody approved, or touching billing. For an explicit request to change how much the Agent may do alone.
name: set_autonomy_level
title: Definir autonomia do Nock Agent
